description: API gateway in front of your app: REST through Apache APISIX and WebSocket through a pub/sub relay, both on the same port and behind the same logins (gantry-auth: Firebase, Cognito, Supabase, JWT or a custom authorizer). Configure routes, auth and the WebSocket connect hooks in the app's gateway.yml; with none it is a transparent proxy to `upstream` and sockets are open.

upstream.help: Where requests go when gateway.yml names no upstream: your app's base URL, without a path. localhost is reached through the Docker host.

node_version.help: Node.js version the WebSocket relay runs on.
